data.title: Imiquimod 5% cream
data.summary: IX Immunomodulators · Imidazoquinoline immune response modifier; Toll-like receptor 7 (TLR7) agonist
data.body:
_Topicals · IX Immunomodulators_

**Class:** Imidazoquinoline immune response modifier; Toll-like receptor 7 (TLR7) agonist

## Mechanism of action
- Activates TLR7 (and TLR8) on dendritic cells and macrophages → release of IFN-α, TNF-α, IL-12
- Boosts innate and Th1 cell-mediated immunity → clears virus-infected and tumour cells; also directly pro-apoptotic

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Approved: external anogenital warts, actinic keratosis, superficial basal cell carcinoma
- Off-label: molluscum (not effective in trials in children), common warts, Bowen disease, lentigo maligna, extramammary Paget disease, keloid (post-excision), cutaneous metastases

## Dose & formulations
- Anogenital warts: 3 times a week at bedtime (e.g. Mon/Wed/Fri), wash off after 6–10 h, up to 16 weeks
- Superficial BCC: 5 times a week for 6 weeks
- Actinic keratosis: twice a week for 16 weeks (5%); 3.75% daily for two 2-week cycles
- Sachets — use one sachet per application; wash hands

## Adverse effects
- Local inflammation (erythema, erosion, crusting, oedema) — often needed for efficacy; rest days if severe
- Flu-like symptoms (fever, myalgia, fatigue) with large areas
- Hypo- or hyperpigmentation; induction or worsening of psoriasis, vitiligo-like depigmentation
- Weakens condoms and diaphragms

## Contraindications
- Hypersensitivity; internal (urethral, intravaginal, cervical, rectal) warts
- Caution: autoimmune disease, psoriasis, immunosuppression, broken skin

## Pregnancy & lactation
Limited data — avoid in pregnancy (old FDA category C); use cryotherapy for warts in pregnancy.

## Viva points
- TLR7 agonist → IFN-α
- Warts: 3 times weekly; sBCC: 5 times weekly × 6 weeks
- Inflammation = sign it is working
- Damages latex condoms

_Sources: Wolverton 4e ch.43 (Topical antivirals — imiquimod) and ch.47; Khopkar ch.23. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
